scenes.title: The Morning After
scenes.summary: Vika prepares coffee in the morning while Max searches for his old watch. Max does not realize it is Vika's birthday.

scenes.title: Stairway to the Sun
scenes.summary: Nastya and Kostya discuss their relationship. Nastya uses a poetic metaphor about a staircase, which leaves Kostya slightly confused.

scenes.title: Hidden Meaning
scenes.summary: Kostya tells Max about Nastya's weird staircase metaphor. Max explains the true meaning of her words and then receives a surprising message from Vika.

scenes.title: Expensive Gift
scenes.summary: Max calls Vika to discuss the expensive ring she sent him. He tries to subtly figure out if she really expects him to buy it.

scenes.title: Serious Conversation
scenes.summary: Nastya approaches Kostya at work for a serious conversation. Kostya is terrified that she wants to talk about marriage.

scenes.title: We Need to Talk
scenes.summary: Nastya stops Kostya to have a serious conversation about their relationship.

scenes.title: An Unexpected Turn
scenes.summary: The serious conversation continues, and Kostya feels a bit confused by Nastya.

scenes.title: A Morning Surprise
scenes.summary: Kostya wakes up and thinks Nastya wants to have fun.

scenes.title: A New Step
scenes.summary: Nastya makes a shocking announcement about her parents visiting.

scenes.title: Dima is Waiting
scenes.summary: The hostess informs Chef Viktor that a special guest is waiting for him.

scenes.title: The Chef's Secret
scenes.summary: The restaurant owner tells the Chef that he is not fired.

scenes.title: Waiting for a Table
scenes.summary: The Chef plans a party to thank the restaurant team.

scenes.title: Important Question
scenes.summary: Max and Kostya discuss their rings and plans to propose.

scenes.title: The New Plan
scenes.summary: Drunk Max interrupts Victoria to give her a ring.

scenes.title: In the Restaurant
scenes.summary: Victoria and Max argue about the important guest.

scenes.title: Old Watch
scenes.summary: Max decides to give his grandfather's watch to a homeless man on the street.

scenes.title: Leaving the Party
scenes.summary: Nastya tries to leave early because she is bored, but Kostya stops her.

scenes.title: An Unexpected Proposal
scenes.summary: Kostya proposes to Nastya, but she rejects him because it ruins her plans.

scenes.title: Selling the Restaurant
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov finds out that Dima sold the restaurant to Eleonora.

scenes.title: Morning
scenes.summary: Elena comes to the apartment where Max and the Chef live early in the morning.

scenes.title: We
scenes.summary: Max thinks about how people behave in life.

scenes.title: Illusions
scenes.summary: Max talks about the illusions we create for ourselves.

scenes.title: Awakening
scenes.summary: A question is left hanging in the air.
